lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the gill slits. The clusters are arranged in approximately five discernible horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns, with spatial spacing increasing in the posterior direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal longitudinal ridges to form a checkerboard pattern. The high-luminance blobs are localized within the center of the rectangular grid cells formed by these intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal features are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from a high-intensity crest to a lower-intensity shadow immediately below each ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of small, circular high-luminance blobs scattered across its visible surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, elongated linear white mark is visible on the dorsal surface of the right pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Several small, dark fusiform silhouettes are visible in the water column adjacent to the ventral side and the right pectoral fin.
